verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs say notes are stored as local plain-text Markdown files and that users have "total control over your data." Community users confirm notes stay local and are fully owned, so local retention and deletion are inherently in the user's hands. However, nothing in the evidence covers retention or deletion controls for Obsidian's cloud services. Sync is only shown to keep version history, and remote vault or Publish deletion is not described. Missing for 10: documented retention settings for Sync version history, documented deletion of remote Sync vaults and Publish sites, account/data deletion policy.
